reason: Independent risk audit needs-correction (cue-content): Both answers fit the narrowed sense of curious, but the card omits an important cross-variety contrast: Indonesian penasaran corresponds to Malaysian panasaran, whose standard meaning is associated with frustrated desire, dissatisfaction, or anger; Malaysian Malay uses ingin tahu for inquisitive curiosity. Also, ingin tahu is possible in Indonesian, so the relation should not imply strict exclusivity.
